{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the trial data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check if there are any other confounding variables (e.g., age, biomarker_baseline, site, arm)
# Stratify by biomarker_baseline (low vs high)
trial_df['biomarker_low'] = (trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] < 0).astype(int)

# Compute response rates within each biomarker stratum by sex
stratified_response = trial_df.groupby(['sex', 'biomarker_low'])['responded'].mean().unstack()
print('Response rates by sex and biomarker baseline (low vs high):')
print(stratified_response)

# Compute difference in response rates within each stratum
diff_low = stratified_response.loc['F', 0] - stratified_response.loc['M', 0]
diff_high = stratified_response.loc['F', 1] - stratified_response.loc['M', 1]

print(f'\nDifference in low biomarker group (F - M): {diff_low:.4f}')
print(f'Difference in high biomarker group (F - M): {diff_high:.4f}')"}
